newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila blue chip shares fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Manila blue chip shares fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Manila share index fell by 66.87 points, or 2.41 percent in midsession on Wednesday to 2,709.66 points pushed down by widespread selling in blue chips, traders said.
"This is just expected because investors took to bargain-hunting even on certain issues without any basis the past two days," said Jidgette Valenzuela, research manager at Lippo Securities.
"The run-up was just too strong. Blue chips surged 20 to 25 percent (in the last two days) and people just had to sell," said Julie Villena, analyst at Magnum International Securities.
Nathan Lozada, Philippine Asia Equity Securities assistant vice president, said the steep losses indicated that the sharp gains since Monday were technical in nature.
Traders said the market may be heading to test the 2,600 support level in the next few days.
